svg.title: A month at the gates
svg.desc: 29,158 access approvals at 13 turnstiles from 28 October to 27 November 2026: approvals per day, and approvals by weekday and hour, highest on weekday evenings.
svg.text: 29,158 access approvals at 13 turnstiles, 28 October – 27 November 2026, from the fleet's own logs
By weekday and hour, local time
Largest weekday-hour total: 803 approvals across Mondays, 19:00–19:59
Bars show complete days; the total and the heatmap include both partial days. Test units excluded.
